description: This file contains a specialized implementation of a quantized depthwise convolution kernel optimized for SSE2 SIMD instructions. It defines the function 'pytorch_q8dwconv_ukernel_mp8x25__sse2' which performs per-channel quantized convolution operations on input data with associated weights, incorporating quantization parameters for zero points, scales, and output clamping. The function processes multiple input channels with vectorized operations, handles edge cases for remaining channels, and integrates requantization and clamping using SSE2 instructions.
